name: Password Sign-In Passkey Required
summary: A user enters through Welcome, chooses email authentication, submits valid password credentials for an account whose only available MFA method is Passkey, receives the generic MFA-required server outcome, and the client routes directly to the existing Passkey Sign In flow.
finalOutcome: The password proof is accepted, no authenticated application session is issued yet, and Passkey-only client response routing places the user on the canonical passkey continuation surface; the existing Passkey Sign In category owns the remaining ceremony.

sourceReferences.note: The server populates availableMfaProviders for the generic MFA-required outcome without choosing the client destination.
Angular Web routes a Passkey-only availableMfaProviders response directly to AuthRoutes.continuePasskey.
React Native recognizes Passkey-only MFA-required responses before session persistence and returns the mfa-passkey outcome.
React Native routes the mfa-passkey password outcome to /auth/continue/passkey.
Canonical Passkey continuation surface is the direct destination when Passkey is the only available MFA method.
A one-element Passkey provider set routes directly to auth.continue.passkey; users with both TOTP and Passkey route to auth.select.mfa-type instead.
